st-dh-dist-dadra-and-nagar-haveli.name: Dadra and Nagar Haveli
st-dh-dist-dadra-and-nagar-haveli.description: District of Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu (Union Territory), India, headquartered at Silvassa. Population approximately 343,709 (2011 census), area approximately 491 km2.

st-dh-dist-daman.name: Daman
st-dh-dist-daman.description: District of Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu (Union Territory), India, headquartered at Daman. Population approximately 191,173 (2011 census), area approximately 72 km2.

st-dh-dist-diu.name: Diu
st-dh-dist-diu.description: District of Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu (Union Territory), India, headquartered at Diu. Population approximately 52,074 (2011 census), area approximately 39 km2.

st-dh-gram-panchayats.name: Gram Panchayats of Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
st-dh-gram-panchayats.description: The village-level tier of Panchayati Raj Institutions in Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu, directly elected under Part IX of the Constitution.
st-dh-gram-panchayats.legalBasis: Constitution of India, Part IX (73rd Amendment, 1992)
st-dh-gram-panchayats.notes: State-wise seat/panchayat count could not be sourced in this research pass: lgdirectory.gov.in's per-state query reports (globalViewStatewiseLocalBody.do and the Download Directory PRI reports) require solving a CAPTCHA to retrieve data, which is outside permitted tooling; only the LGD homepage's national totals (see Local Government of India (aggregate)) were accessible without one. No alternate state-wise secondary source was found before the session's web-search budget was exhausted.

st-dh-panchayat-samitis.name: Panchayat Samitis of Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
st-dh-panchayat-samitis.description: The intermediate (block) tier of Panchayati Raj Institutions in Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu, directly elected under Part IX of the Constitution.
st-dh-panchayat-samitis.legalBasis: Constitution of India, Part IX (73rd Amendment, 1992)
st-dh-panchayat-samitis.notes: State-wise count not sourced; see st-<code>-gram-panchayats notes for why (LGD per-state reports are CAPTCHA-gated).

st-dh-zila-parishads.name: Zila Parishads of Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
st-dh-zila-parishads.description: The district-level tier of Panchayati Raj Institutions in Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu, directly elected under Part IX of the Constitution.
st-dh-zila-parishads.legalBasis: Constitution of India, Part IX (73rd Amendment, 1992)
st-dh-zila-parishads.notes: State-wise count not sourced; see st-<code>-gram-panchayats notes for why (LGD per-state reports are CAPTCHA-gated). Typically one Zila Parishad per district, so the count should be close to (but need not exactly equal) the district count.

st-dh-urban-local-bodies.name: Urban Local Bodies of Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
st-dh-urban-local-bodies.description: The urban local self-government bodies of Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu (municipal corporations, municipalities/municipal councils and nagar/town panchayats), constituted under Part IXA of the Constitution.
st-dh-urban-local-bodies.legalBasis: Constitution of India, Part IXA (74th Amendment, 1992)
st-dh-urban-local-bodies.notes: Only the municipal-corporation count is directly sourced (Wikipedia 'List of municipal corporations in India', cross-validated against the national total of 273 on lgdirectory.gov.in's dashboard). Municipality/nagar-panchayat (municipal council / nagar panchayat) counts per state were not obtainable without the CAPTCHA-gated LGD per-state reports or an additional secondary source, and are left out rather than estimated.

st-dh-dept-home.name: Home Department
st-dh-dept-home.description: Handles police, prisons and internal security administration for the UT.

st-dh-dept-finance.name: Finance Department
st-dh-dept-finance.description: Manages the UT administration's budget, treasury and expenditure control.

st-dh-dept-personnel-ar.name: Department of Personnel and Administrative Reforms
st-dh-dept-personnel-ar.description: Handles civil service recruitment, service matters and administrative reforms.

st-dh-dept-parliamentary-affairs.name: Parliamentary Affairs Department
st-dh-dept-parliamentary-affairs.description: Coordinates the administration's response to Parliament questions concerning the UT.

st-dh-dept-information-technology.name: Information Technology Department
st-dh-dept-information-technology.description: Runs e-governance and digital service delivery for the administration.

st-dh-dept-legal-metrology.name: Department of Legal Metrology (Weights & Measures)
st-dh-dept-legal-metrology.description: Regulates weights, measures and packaged-commodity compliance.

st-dh-dept-municipal-corporation.name: Municipal Corporation
st-dh-dept-municipal-corporation.description: Provides civic services (roads, sanitation, water supply) within municipal limits.

st-dh-dept-electricity.name: Electricity Department
st-dh-dept-electricity.description: Generates and distributes electric power across the UT, run through the DNHDD Power Corporation.

st-dh-dept-tourism.name: Department of Tourism
st-dh-dept-tourism.description: Promotes tourism, including the Statue of Unity gateway and coastal tourism in Daman and Diu.

st-dh-dept-election.name: UT Election Commission
st-dh-dept-election.description: Conducts and oversees elections to municipal and panchayat bodies in the UT.

st-dh-dept-labour-employment.name: Department of Labour and Employment
st-dh-dept-labour-employment.description: Regulates labour welfare, industrial relations and employment services.

st-dh-dept-vat.name: Value Added Tax (VAT) Department
st-dh-dept-vat.description: Administers VAT, GST coordination and commercial tax collection.

st-dh-dept-police.name: UT Police
st-dh-dept-police.description: The UT police force responsible for law and order, crime investigation and traffic policing.

st-dh-dept-irbn.name: India Reserve Battalion
st-dh-dept-irbn.description: An armed police battalion providing reserve law-and-order and security cover for the UT.

st-dh-dept-official-language.name: Official Language (Rajbhasha) Department
st-dh-dept-official-language.description: Promotes the use of Hindi in official government work.

st-dh-dept-block-development.name: Block Development Office
st-dh-dept-block-development.description: Implements rural development schemes at the block level in Dadra and Nagar Haveli.

st-dh-dept-cooperation.name: Department of Cooperative Societies
st-dh-dept-cooperation.description: Regulates and promotes cooperative societies across the UT.

st-dh-dept-accounts.name: Directorate of Accounts
st-dh-dept-accounts.description: Processes government salary, pension payments and treasury accounts.

st-dh-dept-rural-development.name: Department of Rural Development
st-dh-dept-rural-development.description: Implements rural development and community development schemes.

st-dh-dept-fisheries.name: Department of Fisheries
st-dh-dept-fisheries.description: Supports marine and inland fisheries and fisherfolk welfare.

st-dh-dept-fire-emergency.name: Fire and Emergency Services
st-dh-dept-fire-emergency.description: Provides fire-fighting and emergency response services across the UT.

st-dh-dept-town-country-planning.name: Department of Town and Country Planning
st-dh-dept-town-country-planning.description: Prepares development plans and regulates land use and building permissions.

st-dh-dept-planning-statistics.name: Department of Planning and Statistics
st-dh-dept-planning-statistics.description: Coordinates development planning and compiles the UT's official statistics.

st-dh-dept-pollution-control.name: Pollution Control Committee
st-dh-dept-pollution-control.description: Regulates industrial pollution and grants environmental consents.

st-dh-dept-science-technology.name: Science and Technology Department
st-dh-dept-science-technology.description: Promotes scientific research and technology initiatives for the UT.

st-dh-dept-social-welfare.name: Social Welfare Department
st-dh-dept-social-welfare.description: Runs welfare schemes for children, women, the elderly and persons with disabilities.

st-dh-dept-disaster-management.name: State Disaster Management Authority
st-dh-dept-disaster-management.description: Coordinates flood, cyclone and industrial-disaster preparedness and relief.

st-dh-dept-urban-development.name: Department of Urban Development
st-dh-dept-urban-development.description: Oversees municipal bodies, town planning and urban infrastructure.

st-dh-dept-agriculture.name: Agriculture Department
st-dh-dept-agriculture.description: Supports crop farming, soil conservation and horticulture.

st-dh-dept-health.name: Department of Health and Family Welfare
st-dh-dept-health.description: Runs government hospitals and public health programmes across the UT.

st-dh-dept-vigilance.name: Vigilance Department
st-dh-dept-vigilance.description: Investigates corruption complaints against UT government employees.

st-dh-dept-civil-aviation.name: Civil Aviation Department
st-dh-dept-civil-aviation.description: Coordinates airport operations and air connectivity for the UT.

st-dh-dept-industries.name: District Industries Centre
st-dh-dept-industries.description: Promotes small and medium industry and MSME registration.

st-dh-dept-public-grievance.name: Directorate of Public Grievance
st-dh-dept-public-grievance.description: Coordinates redressal of citizen grievances against the administration.

st-dh-dept-education.name: Directorate of Education
st-dh-dept-education.description: Runs government schools and school education programmes.

st-dh-dept-environment-forest.name: Department of Environment and Forest
st-dh-dept-environment-forest.description: Manages forest cover, wildlife and environmental clearances.

st-dh-dept-transport.name: Transport Department
st-dh-dept-transport.description: Regulates road transport, vehicle registration and public bus services.

st-dh-dept-information-publicity.name: Information and Publicity Department
st-dh-dept-information-publicity.description: Runs the government's public information wing and media outreach.

st-dh-dept-higher-technical-education.name: Higher and Technical Education Department
st-dh-dept-higher-technical-education.description: Oversees colleges, polytechnics and technical education institutions.

st-dh-dept-revenue.name: Revenue Department
st-dh-dept-revenue.description: Manages land records, land revenue and revenue courts.

st-dh-dept-district-panchayat.name: District Panchayat
st-dh-dept-district-panchayat.description: Coordinates panchayat-level local self-government and municipal/panchayat elections.

st-dh-dept-excise.name: Excise Department
st-dh-dept-excise.description: Regulates and collects excise duty on liquor and related commodities.

st-dh-dept-port-lighthouse.name: Port and Lighthouse Department
st-dh-dept-port-lighthouse.description: Manages ports, jetties and lighthouses along the Daman and Diu coast.

st-dh-dept-coastal-zone-management.name: Coastal Zone Management Authority
st-dh-dept-coastal-zone-management.description: Regulates development activity within the coastal regulation zone.

st-dh-dept-pwd.name: Public Works Department
st-dh-dept-pwd.description: Builds and maintains government buildings, roads and infrastructure.

st-dh-dept-staff-selection.name: Staff Selection Board
st-dh-dept-staff-selection.description: Recruits UT government staff through competitive selection.

st-dh-dept-food-civil-supplies.name: Department of Food, Civil Supplies and Consumer Affairs
st-dh-dept-food-civil-supplies.description: Administers the public distribution system, essential-commodity supply and consumer-protection enforcement for the UT.

st-dh-dept-tribal-welfare.name: Tribal Welfare Department
st-dh-dept-tribal-welfare.description: Runs welfare and development schemes for the UT's Scheduled Tribe population, which is the majority community in Dadra and Nagar Haveli.

st-dh-dept-mines.name: Mines Department
st-dh-dept-mines.description: Regulates minor-mineral mining and quarrying leases in the UT.

holder.name: Santosh Kumar Meena
holder.notes: IPS (AGMUT:2010). No single DGP or unified Superintendent-of-Police post exists for DNHⅅ per the official portal's current IPS officer roster (ddd.gov.in/ips/, order dated 14 Aug 2025, page last updated 15 Sept 2026) he is the senior-most police officer, holding Deputy Inspector General of Police, DNH&DD plus additional charge as DIG (Prisons) and DIG (Anti-Corruption Unit).
